notes: Sourced from Ashly's official ne24.24M Operating Manual (ashly.com), which includes rear-panel connector diagrams and a full specifications table (section 13). The ne24.24M is a modular base unit: as documented, the chassis ships fixed with 4 balanced analog inputs and 4 balanced analog outputs (all Euroblock/terminal-block, both audio-in-a-box), and is field-expandable with up to 4 plug-in cards (4 channels each, input or output) for up to 24 total audio channels combined — sold under many I/O-configuration SKUs (e.g. NE24.24M-4x12, -12x4, -12x8, -12x12, -20x4, etc., per B&H/Sweetwater/Full Compass listings). One expansion slot can instead hold an optional 8-channel GPO (General Purpose Output) logic card (+12VDC logic out, 10mA source/1A sink per channel) in place of an audio card; this option is not itemized above since it is not part of the base configuration and only one may be installed. This listing documents the fixed base-unit physical I/O (4 in / 4 out + control/power ports); expansion-card audio channels are not separately itemized because the exact channel count/connector labeling depends on which SKU/configuration is purchased. Shipping weight 13 lbs (5.9kg); dimensions 19"L x 3.5"H x 8.5"D.
